Jared (partnerships): FYI - Partner EdgeScale reported hour buckets missing for 2026-03-20 08:00-09:00 UTC. They shared event ids and a sample webhook.
OpsBot: alert: webhook_delivery_latency: partner=edgescale region=eu avg_latency=380s failures=4
Maya (eng-partnerships): quick read of logs: several retries landed >6m later. Our current ack_grace is 5m so they fell into late-path which doesn't update hourly aggregates.
Ola (billing): If we resume those late events without metadata, invoices will look wrong. We need replay_id + billing.replay=true marker for any backfill.
Jared (partnerships): Proposal: (1) add per-partner ack_grace override to 900s behind feature flag, (2) run targeted replay for the provided event ids, (3) tag replayed rows with ledger.source=backfill and replay_id.
Maya (eng-partnerships): I'll open a small PR for the ack_grace flag and a staging replay harness. Staging command will be: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/internal/replay -d '{"partner":"edgescale","events":["e1f2g3"],"dry_run":true}'
```
OpsBot: action: dry_run_job dr-2625010050 created by maya
Ola (billing): Billing checklist: hold invoices for affected hours until reconciliation, add reconciliation_report.csv to partner comms when done, notify customers if adjustment > $1.
Jared (partnerships): Owners & ETA: Maya PR (ETA 4h), Ops probe + alert (ETA 8h), Ola billing hold & template (ETA EOD). I'll message EdgeScale for sign-off on targeted replay.
Maya (eng-partnerships): No objections. Will tag replay events with ingest_path=marketplace and emit metrics.replay.count when finished.
Jared (partnerships): Thanks. Posting backfill id here when queued.
